Title: Voter Captivation and Praxis Seizure: Berlin

Messages.Author: Andy Brown
Messages.Body:
I had a look around google, but couldn't seem to answer the following

If a Ventrue succesfull calls Praxis Seizure: Berlin, and then plays
Voter Captivation, is he able to fill up the increase in capacity, or
does he get that after Voter Cap resolves.

When we played this, I ruled that he would increase first, as the vote
is successful, and then he would fill up. It i important for one of my
players decks, and he wants to be able to lay it in a future tourney.

Cheers

Andy

Andy "Slytherin" Brown

I would say you ruled pretty well there.

***************
Card Text:
Only usable after a successful referendum.

The acting vampire gains X blood from the blood bank, where X is the
number of votes the referendum passed by.
As above, but up to 2 of those blood counters go to your pool instead of
this vampire.
****************

The referendum has been successful therefore the vote has passed and the
chosen Ventrue's cap has increased and has the new title **then** you
play Voter Cap and allocate the blood/pool gain as you see fit.
